claims.text: How Does the USA Compare on High School Completion?
claims.support: USA upper secondary education completion rate is 91.6% (rank 10).
Upper secondary education completion rates vary widely across countries.

claims.text: Comparing adult high school completion rates across the globe using World Bank data.
claims.support: World Bank indicator SE.SEC.CUAT.UP.ZS measures upper secondary education attainment.

claims.text: In Turkmenistan, 98.4% of adults finished high school. In Niger, it's just 1.7%.
The USA sits near the top, with 91.6% of adults completing high school.
Other major economies lag behind: India has 41.3%, while China has 31.8%.
Central Asia leads: Turkmenistan is at 98.4%, Uzbekistan 96.8%, and Kazakhstan 94.3%.
It counts the percentage of population ages 25 and over that attained or completed upper secondary education.
claims.support: Definition: The percentage of population ages 25 and over that attained or completed upper secondary education.

claims.text: At the bottom, Senegal has 8.4% and Mali has 7.2%.
